oneLiner: A dashboard that helps PMs re-orient when switching between projects, showing the last decision made, blockers, and who's waiting on what.
problem: Product managers frequently context-switch between multiple projects and lose momentum due to forgotten decisions, invisible blockers, and unclear dependency chains. This leads to delayed communications, duplicated work, and stalled initiatives.
coreFlow: User lands on dashboard and sees all active projects
User clicks a project to view re-orientation snapshot
Snapshot displays: last decision made, current blockers, and pending dependencies
User can acknowledge they've reviewed the snapshot or drill deeper into specific items
User can update blockers or dependencies directly from the view

screens.name: Project Grid
screens.purpose: Show all active projects at a glance with time-since-last-visit indicator and number of pending items

screens.name: Project Snapshot
screens.purpose: Display the essential re-orientation info: last decision, active blockers, and who's waiting on PM

screens.name: Decision Log
screens.purpose: Show recent decisions for the project with timestamps and context

screens.name: Blocker Board
screens.purpose: List all blockers with owner, priority, and estimated resolution date

screens.name: Dependency View
screens.purpose: Visualize tasks/decisions waiting on the PM and tasks the PM is waiting on from others

outOfScope: Full project management (timelines, resource allocation, roadmap planning)
Integrations with all third-party tools (can start with Slack, Linear, or Jira)
